vm._note: The hypervisor of the virtual machines module. list prints one <name><TAB>running|stopped per machine and fails when the hypervisor does not answer; configure tells it about the <pool>/vm dataset.
vm.list: out=$(vm list) && printf '%s\n' "$out" | awk 'NR>1 && NF {{ print $1 "\t" (/Running/ ? "running" : "stopped") }}'
